page.overview:
Who is Pegasus?

Pegasus is an unintroduced character in Invincible who is implied to become a member of the Guardians of the Globe. Her suit has been shown being created by Art Rosenbaum, suggesting a future appearance in the series. It is currently unknown when or if she will formally debut.
